---
title: "DatasetPrep"
output: html_document
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load data}
prev_clean <- read.csv('clean_2010.csv')
demo <- read.csv('democracy2020.csv')
```

```{r}
clean_wo_resp <- prev_clean |> 
  select(- daily_income)
```

```{r}
head(demo)

dataset <- inner_join(clean_wo_resp, demo)

dataset_unnamed <- dataset |>
  select(- name)
```

```{r}
write.csv(dataset_unnamed, "clean_mini2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
